🙋 Feature Request

<!--- Provide a general summary of the issue in the title above -->

### 🤔 Expected Behavior

Window's should fall back to icons that it supports and can render.

### 😯 Current Behavior

Window's renders colored boxes instead of ⌛️ ✨:


![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4730164/34235793-ffac013a-e5c1-11e7-8e02-cb2063b5177f.png)


### 💁 Possible Solution

We could leverage something like [log-symbols](https://www.npmjs.com/package/log-symbols) to provide fallbacks. Alternatively, just detect Windows and conditionally show the existing ⌛️ ✨ vs other compatible icons.
